summary: Clean modern production: tight low end, sidechain, bright and wide, controlled dynamics, nothing dusty
body: The opposite of production/lofi: remove crushers and low-passes, raise the high end, keep the low end mono and tight.
Kick and bass don't overlap (sidechain the bass and pads to the kick), drums punchy and up front, short reverbs.
No chain for it yet: mostly removing dusty effects, then EQ and compression.
